notes.note: #0.9-17 finish the party-leader block begun in story_126 (#0.3-8). Voiced from wording: #0.9 soft (dane), #0.10/#0.13 rough, #0.14 polite; identical JP -> identical EN.

#0.20-33 leader block (14 copies). Labels Ankh/?party on #0.20/#0.21 likely shifted; identical JP -> identical EN.
Barge Cannon per glossary. #0.4-18 leader block; two JP wordings (daijoubu-sou / mondai wa nasa-sou) kept as two EN wordings.

Speaker labels in 0648 appear offset by one row (each label belongs to the row before): #0.7 laugh and #0.24-25 mock-polite lines are Gaddess (Hiling), #0.23 and #0.27 are Deathscythe Hell (Duo), #0.26 silent row is Epyon. Pain cries #0.2-6 thus Heavyarms, Sandrock, (Virgo silent), Birth, Deathscythe. Interjections only, so the call does not change the English.
